_comment: Copy this file to pricelabs-feeds.config.json for local runs, OR paste the same JSON shape into the PRICELABS_FEEDS_JSON GitHub Actions secret. Keys are stayatflorida.com listing IDs (matching config.js PROPERTIES[].id). 'pricelabsListingId' + 'pms' must match a connected channel in PriceLabs (GET /v1/listings_minimal). Airbnb is the usual source of truth when multiple OTAs are connected.
